animations.name: idle
animations.plays_when: intent ambient or unobservable (neutral variant)

animations.name: walk
animations.plays_when: any move between points; 4 directions (SE, SW, NE, NW), NE/NW may mirror

animations.name: look_around
animations.plays_when: ambient

animations.name: sit_down
animations.plays_when: arriving at a seat

animations.name: stand_up
animations.plays_when: intent work_done, or leaving a seat

animations.name: work
animations.plays_when: intent work (generic: no typing, thinking or building claim)

animations.name: typing
animations.plays_when: only with a future observed typing signal; not available in topology@1

animations.name: thinking
animations.plays_when: only with a future observed thinking signal; not available in topology@1

animations.name: building
animations.plays_when: only with a future observed build signal; not available in topology@1

animations.name: coffee
animations.plays_when: ambient at coffee or counter point

animations.name: eat
animations.plays_when: ambient at counter point

animations.name: sit_sofa
animations.plays_when: ambient at sofa_sit

animations.name: sleep
animations.plays_when: ambient at sofa_lie (decorative nap, not a session state)

animations.name: stretch
animations.plays_when: ambient

animations.name: sweep
animations.plays_when: ambient wander

animations.name: chat
animations.plays_when: two ambient pets at meeting seats (decorative, never claims agents talk)

animations.name: happy
animations.plays_when: intent work_done (short, then stand_up)

animations.name: notification
animations.plays_when: intent attention: '!' bubble at the own desk

animations.name: finishing
animations.plays_when: intent finishing: '...' bubble, still seated

animations.name: unknown
animations.plays_when: intent unobservable: dimmed, '?' bubble, seat kept

animations.name: error
animations.plays_when: reserved for an observed error state; topology@1 has none

animations.name: enter
animations.plays_when: presentation.new: from the door to the assigned seat or an ambient point

animations.name: exit
animations.plays_when: intent exit only (confirmed end): walk to the door, fade at the threshold
